intro: The Glyphic Memorandum is a written notice delivered to novice mages arriving in Coldridge Valley. Penned on behalf of the mage trainer Marryk Nurribit, it directs fledgling spellcasters indoors to begin their formal arcane instruction.

p: Novice spellcasters setting out into the bitter frost of Coldridge Valley receive this brief missive after completing their initial tasks. Authored by the local mage trainer Marryk Nurribit, the memorandum summons young practitioners into the warmth of Anvilmar. Rather than stern academic dogma, Marryk's guidance is informal and blunt: learn your incantations, set aside coin for training and tavern ale, and steer well clear of the irradiated ruin of Gnomeregan.
